description: Gives the Camelot wheel code for a key and the three other keys that mix cleanly with it (one step either way with the same letter, and the relative major or minor).

key.description: Musical key: a name like "A minor", "Am", "F#m", "Bb major", "C", or a Camelot code like "8A".

name: camelot
title: Camelot code and compatible keys
